symbolic.single_cosine_hessian: Matrix([[Lambda4*cos(a/f + phi/F)/f**2, Lambda4*cos(a/f + phi/F)/(F*f)], [Lambda4*cos(a/f + phi/F)/(F*f), Lambda4*cos(a/f + phi/F)/F**2]])
symbolic.trough: h=0 (mod2pi*f*F/sqrt(f^2+F^2)), a=-f*phi/F; massive eigenvalue constant along l
symbolic.corrected_scale_relation: If b=MP*tan(theta)/(2F), then F/MP=tan(theta)/(2b), not1/(2b*tan(theta)). This conditional algebra does not establish a varying physical mass.

convex_controls.interpretation: Standard Hellmann-Feynman plus Cauchy-Schwarz application on positive-cosine branches. Sampled verification, not a theorem derived by random search.
convex_controls.inequality: |MP*dln(mH)/dl| <= MP/2*sqrt((u^T H u)/lambdaH)*max_i |(qi.eH)*tan(qi.x)|, for canonical unit direction u, all Ai*cos(qi.x)>0. The scan uses u=eL. No claim for hilltops, negative cosine weights, cancellations or changing kinetic metric.

single_cosine_dynamics.scope: Two canonical fields in Minkowski time; no cosmological fit. Light velocity changes without changing the heavy trajectory. A separate light potential/interaction would change the model.

running_eft_control.scope: Audit of declared phenomenological mass law in d4c3be9c7. Fi=0 is a separately switched control in the code, not its continuous limit at fixed nonzero beta0. Does not establish a physical axion eigenmass or re-run CLASS.

scope: Single mixed cosine has one exactly flat canonical direction; its relaxed heavy mass does not vary along that direction. A stated quadratic pinning extension and convex three-cosine controls are tested separately. Does not exclude multi-cosine monodromy, finite-density effects, curved field metrics or full axion models. No full cosmological background/perturbation likelihood or naturalness completion.
